title: db2bibtex: export HJA/LTER publications from SQL Server to BibTeX or RIS for Zotero

creators.name: Kennedy, Adam
creators.affiliation: H.J. Andrews Experimental Forest LTER, Oregon State University

description: Exports Published H.J. Andrews Experimental Forest and Long-Term Ecological Research (LTER) publications from a SQL Server publication database to BibTeX or RIS, for import into Zotero. Provides command-line interfaces for both formats (db2bibtex, db2ris), a tkinter GUI for the BibTeX workflow, and post-import Zotero API tools to repair truncated author lists and Newspaper/Magazine Articles misclassified as Journal Articles.
notes: This material is based upon work supported by the H.J. Andrews Experimental Forest and Long Term Ecological Research (LTER) program under the NSF grant LTER8 DEB-2025755.
